Your mission

Jane Goodall: An 8-Day Journey Through Her Life

Use your class copy of “From My Life with the Chimpanzees” by Jane Goodall and the research shelf below. Complete short guided activities, a video observation, and auto-scored knowledge checks. Read along with your class during Days 1–4; finish the reading questions on Day 6. Days 6–8 include easy matching and review.

💾 Work saves in this browser on this device when storage is available. It does not sync across devices or submit to your teacher. Download a backup at the end of every session. On a shared iPad, use a separate browser profile or restore your own backup before working.

Your research shelf

Reading guide: start with the National Geographic Kids interview; on the Institute biography, read “Jane’s Story” and the relevant FAQ sections. The interview records an earlier conversation; compare its date and wording with the updated biography.

Use the assigned article or page only. Do not follow advertisements, donation buttons, comments, sign-up offers, or unrelated videos. If a page is blocked or a section is hard to read, ask your teacher for a short printed passage or read together. Sites can change; your teacher should preview them on the school network.

The autobiography excerpt is the anchor text; websites add context. Keep fact, inference, and your opinion separate. Write your own words. Copy only a brief quotation when you explain it and identify its source. Photos on websites are not automatically free to reuse: use your own drawings or teacher-approved images with credits.
